Lyrics:

VERSE 1
Mere sajjan methon door ne wasde…
My beloved lives far away from me…
Main rowaan oh vi na hasde
I keep crying, while even they no longer smile.
Jind saadi dohan di kurlai
Our lives are both filled with pain and longing. 
Rabb jaane kihdi nazar hai laggi…
Only God knows whose evil eye has cast its shadow on us… 
Satt saade dil te wajji
Our hearts have been deeply wounded. 
Dil saada denda aye duhai duhai duhai
My heart keeps crying out for help, again and again.

 
CHORUS
Eh chandri judai judai judai
This wretched separation, this painful distance… 
Jaandi saanu mukaai mukaai mukaai
It is slowly destroying us, taking us to the edge.
Ho kardo rehayi rehayi rehayi
Oh, please set us free, please give us relief…
 

Rehayi Es jagg ton
Free us from this world.
 
 VERSE 2

De de dua ve menu…
Please bless me with your prayers…
 
Sohna milaade menu…
Please reunite me with my beloved… 
Sohne bina ve mere supne adhoore
Without my beloved, all my dreams remain incomplete. 
Ikko gila aye menu…
I have only one complaint… 
Deke wafaa ve menu…
You promised me your love and loyalty…

Kitte na waade “Anmol” ve poore
But you never fulfilled the promises you made to me, Anmol.
 
Jaane o jaane o khuda…
Oh God, only You know…
 
Khuda ve saari
Oh God, all of it…
Waari main waari sajjna…
I would sacrifice myself for you, my beloved…
Main jaawan waari
I would give everything for you. 
Reh gayi main ban parchhayi…
I am left behind like nothing but a shadow…
 
CHORUS
Eh chandri judai judai judai
This wretched separation, this painful distance…
Jaandi saanu mukaai mukaai mukaai
It is slowly destroying us, taking us to the edge. 
Ho kardo rehayi rehayi rehayi
Oh, please set us free, please give us relief… 
Rehayi Es jagg ton
Free us from this world.
